difficultyRationale: Checks the basic mechanism behind runtime polymorphism (dynamic dispatch) using a direct, unambiguous snippet.
explanation: Instance methods in Java are dispatched based on the actual runtime type of the object a reference points to, not the declared (static) type of the reference variable. Because a refers to an actual Dog object at runtime, the overridden sound() in Dog runs, printing "Woof". This dynamic (virtual) method dispatch is the mechanism that makes polymorphism work.
